capabilities: Convert PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, and image files to Markdown via right-click
Split PDFs longer than 200 pages and merge the results into one file
Store extracted images in an images/ sidecar folder
Batch-convert files with an included Python tool
extras: Full user guide, API notes, and changelog are hosted outside the README; the listing carries the standard warning that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The repository also contains Python tools that pre-date the plugin (a 252-file batch converter).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn binary documents like PDFs and Office files into editable Markdown notes from inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Let MinerU's accurate-parse API and Obsidian work together

summary: Right-click converter that sends PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, and image files to the MinerU parse API and saves the result as Markdown in the vault.
